sections.en:
A = Laur. 28, 34. I have noted the various readings of cod. Laur. 28. 14, f. 243r (B) which
Bidez described to me. Cod. Vindobon. Phil. 115, f. 157v provides the same excerpt.
1 περὶ τῶν κ. τοῦ ἀερος ('concerning the c. of the air') B. 2 περὶ ('concerning') omitted by B. ἐνιαυσιέου ('annual') A. 2-5 καταστήματος ἀπὸ ('of the condition from')
τῆς τοῦ κυνὸς ἐπιτολῆς σκέπτου· ἐν γὰρ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ καθ’ ἣν ἄρχεται ἐπιτέλ- ('the rising of the dog star observe; for on this day on which it begins to rise')
λειν ('to rise') (supplied by ὁ Κύων ('the Dog')) μετὰ δύσιν ('after setting') B. 4-5 the gloss μᾶλλον ... ἡμέρᾳ ('rather ... day') I have enclosed in brackets. 6 εἰ ('if')
A. παρ’ αὐτὰ ('alongside them') A. εὐθὺ μετὰ τὸ δῦναι ('immediately after setting') B. 8 μηνὸς — τοῦ μηνὸς ('of the month — of the month') omitted by B. εἰ ('if') A.
εἰ ('if') A. 9 ἅμα τῇ ('together with the') conjectured by Kroll. τὰ αὐτὰ ('the same things') A. φανῇ ('should appear') B. τοῦ τέλους ('of the end') A. 10 κατὸ ('according to') A.
11 μοίρᾳ ('degree') conjectured by Kroll. 12 ἐὰν ('if') B : εἰ ('if') A. τὰ νέφη ('the clouds') omitted by A. φάλαγγα ('phalanx') B. 13 ἀέρα ('air')
understand as wind cf. p. 172, 9. δροσιὰ ('dew') (A) for δρόσος ('dew') (B) is also said today.
γένηται ('should become') A.

summary.headline: Alexandrian Horoscope and Weather Omens
summary.text: Astrological example for Alexandria, using Diocletian’s reign and Alexandrian Athyr to calculate stellar epochs, centers, lots, and planetary positions according to Ptolemy. Syrus’s universal instruction on annual conditions begins, interpreting clouds, hail, dew, and nighttime air from the Dog’s rising and the timing of appearances.
